elements.label: Read this reference map
Plinko Pocket Sensemaker
elements.description:
Build a provenance-preserving systems-mapping application: clear graph/evidence, durable edits and recovery, reusable maps and views, and a locally testable privacy boundary. Preserve the existing viewer and main while new work proceeds separately. Kumu informs interaction requirements; full Kumu parity, zero operating or labor cost, and privacy without enforcement are not promised.

References: [Public application repository](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker)

elements.label: Audited v1 baseline
elements.description:
At audit commit 19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0: six application files, 44 nodes, 52 edges, 65 evidence records, two sources and five tour stops. Embedded graph and graph.json are equal after parsing. IDs and graph references passed checks. Storage is in memory; JSON export contains graph data, not durable maps/views/pins. These are pinned-baseline facts, not a claim about later implementation.

Isolated access to missing embedded.validation.segmentIds threw TypeError. Full app startup remains untested. Source also predicts stale 3D updates from captured render handlers; that prediction needs a browser test.

References: [v1 data](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/graph.json) · [v1 schema](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/graph.schema.json) · [Viewer source](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/index.html) · [Spatial source](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/spatial.js)

elements.label: Graph and evidence core
elements.description:
Own stable node/edge IDs, relationship direction, source identity, evidence, epistemic status and tours. Preserve parallel edges, unknown legacy fields and originalStatus. Explicit means directly stated in a source, not independently true. Review acceptance must not convert a proposal into a fact. Graph meaning stays independent of coordinates and visual styles.

References: [Current contract](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/graph.schema.json)

elements.label: v1 ↔ v2 compatibility adapter
elements.description:
Initial compatibility behavior is implemented in the separate work: byte-identical v1 round trips plus provenance/unknown-field preservation passed automated checks. The broader A1 gate remains incomplete. Target contract: a separate v2 envelope and dedicated v1 adapter. Keep original v1 bytes and digest for exact restoration; preserve every semantic value in a no-op round trip, including nulls, quotations, overlay/SKU fields, ordered tours and unknown extensions. A v1 projection must report excluded v2 content and fail when faithful export is impossible. Never silently truncate or invent five tour stops.

References: [v1 schema](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/graph.schema.json) · [Ingestion contract](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/ingestion.md)

elements.label: Four independent validation gates
elements.description:
Validate (1) shape and resource limits, (2) uniqueness/references/map membership/revisions, (3) source identity and quote/locator exactness against retained authorized bytes, and (4) human semantic support. Passing structure must not label evidence verified. Stage parse, checks and derived-state preflight before one committed import.

References: [Current schema](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/graph.schema.json) · [Current validation and load](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/index.html)

elements.label: SQLite and source-artifact storage
elements.description:
The first storage/API foundation passed 13 automated tests, including conflicting saves, transaction rollback and backup restore after reopening SQLite. This is automated foundation evidence, not completed UI/end-to-end acceptance. Target architecture: a single-user local service with transactional SQLite records and content-addressed source artifacts; source-artifact implementation is not separately confirmed. Revisions prevent stale writes. Record representation identity and hash scope honestly. Browser storage can cache data but is not the only archive. Source retention and rights need an explicit policy.

References: [Audited repository tree](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/tree/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0)

elements.label: Shared query and visibility layer
elements.description:
One validated filter evaluator derives visible node/edge IDs for canvas, accessible list, counts, optional 3D and export preview. Define missing values, hidden endpoints, self-loops, parallel edges and neighborhood rules. Include clear/reset and an explanatory empty state. Hiding is not deletion or access control.

References: [Current SVG behavior](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/index.html) · [Current 3D behavior](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/spatial.js)

elements.label: Command-based graph editor
elements.description:
Editor implementation is underway and is not yet verified complete. Target: create/edit nodes and edges through commands with stable identity, expected revisions, validation and explicit undo/recovery boundaries. Support duplicate labels, parallel edges and endpoint changes without losing edge metadata. Keep graph edits distinct from layout drags and view drafts.

References: [Current viewer baseline](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/index.html)

elements.label: 2D primary renderer and list
elements.description:
Use a 2D editing foundation with keyboard selection, visible focus, readable labels and accessible table/list alternatives. Cytoscape.js is the proposed graph foundation, subject to final technical selection. Measure representative graph sizes and cancellation needs before promising performance. Keep renderer-specific state outside the canonical graph.

References: [Cytoscape.js official documentation](https://js.cytoscape.org/) · [Existing SVG viewer](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/index.html)

elements.label: Optional 3D reading adapter
elements.description:
Retain the spatial reading/navigation experience as an optional adapter over the same derived graph. Test filter parity, selection, evidence inspection, context loss and 2D fallback. Do not infer analytics, causal simulation or durable layouts from library names. The existing 3D implementation is baseline code, not a completed v2 adapter.

References: [Existing 3D source](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/spatial.js)

elements.label: Maps, layouts and persistent pins
elements.description:
Maps own membership, groups and layout snapshots; the project owns graph entities. A node can have different positions in different maps. Removing membership must not delete the entity. Store finite coordinates, pinned state, layout parameters/seed and revision. Layout drafts need Save/Revert, and dragging must not alter evidence or topology.

References: [Kumu map/data distinction](https://docs.kumu.io/overview/kumus-architecture)

elements.label: Reusable saved views and styles
elements.description:
Project-level presets contain typed filter/style/label/renderer rules and applicability metadata. Optional map bindings select compatible layouts and overrides. Keep draft and saved revisions distinct, with Save/Revert, independent duplication, deterministic rule order, missing-value handling and legends. Rules are declarative and allowlisted, not executable imports.

References: [Kumu view model](https://docs.kumu.io/guides/views) · [Filter reference](https://docs.kumu.io/guides/filter)

elements.label: Evidence and provenance inspector
elements.description:
Show quoted support, source representation, locators, original status and separate verification/review states. Preserve unavailable/null segments and speakers. Surface mismatch, unavailable artifacts, competing claims and interpretation rationale. A digest establishes byte identity for a stated representation, not truth or authorship.

References: [Current evidence records](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/graph.json) · [Ingestion requirements](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/ingestion.md)

elements.label: Versioned backup and restore
elements.description:
Backup restore after reopening SQLite passed within the 13-test foundation suite. Full UI, clean-release and artifact-retention acceptance remain open. Target: a lossless v2 project bundle with records, layout/view revisions and source references/artifacts as permitted. Demonstrate restore into a clean data directory. Keep original v1 bytes for exact restoration. Reviewed sharing/export is separate from backup; hidden, deleted or private content must not leak through exports. Visual exports remain derivatives.

References: [Current export source](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/index.html) · [Kumu export reference](https://docs.kumu.io/guides/export)

elements.label: Local/private release packaging
elements.description:
Bundle required scripts, fonts and assets locally. Test with outbound networking denied; inspect network logs. Use restrictive policy, origin/path defenses and bounded imports. The first target is a single-user loopback service. Team/LAN/public service needs authenticated project authorization, TLS and retention controls before exposure. Self-hosted does not automatically mean private.

References: [Current remote module dependencies](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/index.html)

elements.label: Bounded ingestion boundary
elements.description:
Keep extraction separate from interactive mapping. Start with deterministic local imports; no mapping interaction should trigger model extraction. Any model-assisted processing must name provider, source scope, budget and consent boundary. Preserve original and derived representation identity separately. The existing ingestion file is a specification, not an implemented extractor.

References: [Ingestion specification](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/ingestion.md)

elements.label: Kumu public viewer observations
elements.description:
Public tests on 8 October 2026 observed independent map/view selection, element deep links, reversible filters with hidden counts and an empty state, plus styling/layout control affordances. These are viewer observations. Creating/editing data, saving layouts/views, conflicts and import/export were not exercised. They inform requirements without establishing implementation parity.

References: [Observed public example](https://kumu.io/dan/a-network-of-thrones#geography) · [Map/view documentation](https://docs.kumu.io/overview/kumus-architecture)

elements.label: REA setup and readiness
elements.description:
Package rea-agents 6.0.0 was checked against registry integrity and release signatures. Packaged no-change setup planning passed. Approved stable-target setup completed. Standalone MCP initialization, discovery of 139 advertised tools and a target-free test request passed. The current client has not refreshed its connected tools; restart/reconnect is needed before session usability can be verified. Certificate/transparency-chain and full dependency-provenance validation remain incomplete. Standalone discovery does not establish active-session tools or usable browser providers.

References: [REA upstream project](https://github.com/morluto/rea) · [Versioned npm artifact](https://registry.npmjs.org/rea-agents/-/rea-agents-6.0.0.tgz)

elements.label: Implementation underway
elements.description:
Implementation was approved after review of the architecture audit and is underway separately. The storage/API foundation passed 13 automated tests: byte-identical v1 round trips, provenance and unknown-field retention, conflicting saves, transaction rollback and backup restore after reopening SQLite. Editor work continues. Full application/UI completion, merge, push, deployment and Kumu import are not confirmed by this reference. Preserve main/current viewer. A0–A7 show the audited dependency plan and acceptance targets; their individual gates must be evidenced before claiming completion.

References: [Public repository](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker)

elements.label: A0 · Reproduce the baseline
elements.description: Complete isolated runtime testing at the pinned audit commit. Resolve the sandboxed-browser ownership blocker through an approved route.
elements.Acceptance: Record actual startup/console and fixture hashes; classify source predictions as reproduced or not reproduced. Test fallback and filter behavior. Preserve main and deployment.

elements.label: A1 · Freeze compatibility and adapter
elements.description: Initial byte-identical v1 round-trip and provenance/unknown-field checks passed in the foundation suite. Continue freezing fixtures and completing separate adapter, standards-based validation and integrity acceptance.
elements.Acceptance: No-op v1 semantic round trip; byte-exact original restore; unknown-field retention; honest provenance; explicit export limitations; malformed and over-limit inputs rejected.

elements.label: A2 · Unify state and visibility
elements.description: Separate state, commands and derived visible graph. Isolate legacy renderers and explicitly scoped startup/event repairs.
elements.Acceptance: Canvas, list and optional 3D agree on visible IDs, counts and relationship meaning for status/source/overlay/tour/neighborhood filters. Regression evidence before proposing a legacy change.

elements.label: A3 · Persist, import and recover
elements.description: Storage/API foundation implemented; 13 automated checks passed, including conflicts, rollback and SQLite reopen/restore. Continue UI and full atomic import/recovery acceptance. This milestone is not complete.
elements.Acceptance: Saved project survives restart/crash; stale revision cannot overwrite; clean restore yields equivalent records and source references; rejected or interrupted import leaves committed state unchanged.

elements.label: A4 · Edit graphs with evidence
elements.description: Editor implementation underway, not yet verified complete. Add node/edge commands and an evidence inspector using shared visibility and durable revisions.
elements.Acceptance: Stable IDs, duplicate labels, parallel edges, self-loops, endpoint edits, status handling and undo/recovery pass. Human acceptance never upgrades a proposal to a source fact.

elements.label: A5 · Save maps, layouts and pins
elements.description: Add multiple maps with independent layout drafts, explicit saves and persistent pins.
elements.Acceptance: Independent positions across maps; membership removal keeps graph entity; finite coordinates; save/revert and deterministic default layout; dragging changes no evidence or topology.

elements.label: A6 · Reuse views, filters and styles
elements.description: Add reusable project-level view presets, applicability, typed filters and safe style rules.
elements.Acceptance: Save/Revert/reload and independent duplication; map compatibility; explanatory empty states; deterministic rule order, missing values and legends; no executable imported rules.

elements.label: A7 · Package and verify release
elements.description: Package an offline local release and complete accessibility, security, export and recovery regression.
elements.Acceptance: No required external requests with egress denied; usable keyboard/list fallback; demonstrated clean backup restore; safe import/text boundaries; privacy-reviewed export and dependency notices.

elements.label: Gate · Compatibility and integrity
elements.description: No-op semantic equality; exact original-byte restore; nested unknown-field retention; duplicate/dangling IDs and invalid types rejected; cycles, multi-edges and self-loops covered.
elements.Acceptance: No-op semantic equality; exact original-byte restore; nested unknown-field retention; duplicate/dangling IDs and invalid types rejected; cycles, multi-edges and self-loops covered.

elements.label: Gate · Runtime and renderer parity
elements.description: Pinned browser startup and console evidence; same visible IDs/counts across supported renderers; 3D loss/fallback; filter and empty-state regressions; no source prediction counted as runtime proof.
elements.Acceptance: Pinned browser startup and console evidence; same visible IDs/counts across supported renderers; 3D loss/fallback; filter and empty-state regressions; no source prediction counted as runtime proof.

elements.label: Gate · Atomicity and recovery
elements.description: Crash/restart recovery; rollback under interrupted save or preflight failure; explicit revision conflicts; equivalent records and source references after clean backup restore.
elements.Acceptance: Crash/restart recovery; rollback under interrupted save or preflight failure; explicit revision conflicts; equivalent records and source references after clean backup restore.

elements.label: Gate · Editing and provenance
elements.description: Stable identity through edits; evidence/unknowns/hash scope preserved; exactness mismatch visible; no verified badge without authorized source bytes; acceptance does not change epistemic status.
elements.Acceptance: Stable identity through edits; evidence/unknowns/hash scope preserved; exactness mismatch visible; no verified badge without authorized source bytes; acceptance does not change epistemic status.

elements.label: Gate · Map and view independence
elements.description: Independent map coordinates; membership-safe removal; drafts separate from saved revisions; save/revert/duplicate/switch/reload tested; styles cannot mutate graph meaning.
elements.Acceptance: Independent map coordinates; membership-safe removal; drafts separate from saved revisions; save/revert/duplicate/switch/reload tested; styles cannot mutate graph meaning.

elements.label: Gate · Private, usable release
elements.description: Denied-egress test and network inspection; all required assets local; keyboard/list and assistive-technology paths; bounded untrusted input; origin/path controls; notices and reviewed exports; measured performance targets.
elements.Acceptance: Denied-egress test and network inspection; all required assets local; keyboard/list and assistive-technology paths; bounded untrusted input; origin/path controls; notices and reviewed exports; measured performance targets.

elements.label: Preserve main and current viewer
elements.description:
Keep the current viewer and main intact while work proceeds separately. New schema work must use a versioned adapter and separate application boundary. A successful test or approved implementation does not by itself authorize replacing the current viewer or deploying.

References: [Current viewer](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/index.html)

elements.label: Local single-user deployment first
elements.description: Prefer a loopback-only service, SQLite and local source artifacts for the first durable release. Confirm the operating environment and recovery responsibility during implementation. Broader team access is later scope with its own authentication and authorization requirements.

elements.label: 2D first; 3D optional
elements.description:
Use 2D and an accessible list as the primary editing/inspection foundation. Keep 3D as optional reading/navigation until parity and fallback tests pass. Cytoscape.js is proposed; selection should account for interaction goals, packaging, performance and license review.

References: [Cytoscape.js](https://js.cytoscape.org/) · [Existing spatial experience](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/spatial.js)

elements.label: Decide source retention and sharing
elements.description: Define which source artifacts may be retained, representation/hash scope, deletion/retention and approved export audience. The public reference map contains only approved project details, not private source text. View filters are not a privacy boundary; review/redact exports before sharing.

elements.label: Select app license and notices
elements.description:
The audited application tree had no LICENSE file. Choose a license for owned code before redistribution and review dependency notices/SBOM. App licensing does not establish rights to source datasets or transcripts. Verify the state again before release.

References: [Audited repository tree](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/tree/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0)

elements.label: Browser runtime validation blocked
elements.description: The isolated browser stopped before page load because Chromium sandbox-helper ownership was invalid. A supported alternative Firefox download was denied by network policy; no bypass was attempted. Security/sandbox settings were not weakened. Actual Sensemaker startup, import/export and 3D interaction still need a supported test route. This blocks evidence for A0 runtime acceptance, not source analysis or all implementation work.

elements.label: Original evidence bytes unavailable
elements.description:
Original transcript bytes and deterministic segments were unavailable in the audit; all 65 baseline evidence segment IDs are null. The recorded digest identifies a rendered-text representation, not original-upload bytes. Quote exactness and semantic support cannot be independently upgraded to verified from these records alone.

References: [Baseline evidence data](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/graph.json) · [Required evidence workflow](https://github.com/Jmx097/plinko-pocket-sensemaker/blob/19a3d38649fd53cebe1bb8296ebae8df8a2079f0/ingestion.md)

elements.label: Kumu authoring/import tests pending
elements.description:
The public project exists, but this reference import has not been performed. Authoring, persisted view/layout changes and real import behavior remain untested. Online authoring verification could not be completed in this run. Do not infer a successful map edit, saved view or import from file validation.

References: [Target public project](https://kumu.io/Jmx097/plinko-pocket) · [Official import format](https://docs.kumu.io/guides/import/blueprints)
